The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Bidder shall be Manufacturer of Drainage belt (i.e. Belt TS(Italy)/ Dongli (Korea)/ Contitech(Germany) as m entioned in the tender or Horizontal belt filter supplier – OES (i.e. M/S Takraf India pvt ltd/ M/S Flsmidth/ M/ S V Mix mineral technologies pvt ltd ) or their authorized dealers. Authorized dealers shall submit valid ten der specific authorized dealership certificate from Manufacturer/OES, along with part-1 of their offer failing which their offer shall be rejected. 2. In case both manufacturer and authorized dealer participate in the tender, only manufacturer offer shall be considered. 3. Bidder shall submit an order copy (order copy may be on the participated bidder name or in the name of O EM/OES is acceptable) along with relevant invoice copies and order completion certificate for supply and re placement of transporter belt/ new installation of transporter belt i.e. complete horizontal belt filter of filtra tion area minimum of 33sq. mtr during the last seven years, ending with last date of previous month on w hich date tender is floated on which tender is floated. To legally establish this qualification, their correspon ding tax invoices, order completion certificate must fall strictly within seven-year period. Accordingly, the bidder is required to submit clear, legible copies of this past order alongside their matching tax invoices, o rder completion certificates, along with part-1 of their offer failing which their offer shall be rejected. 4. Bidder's minimum average financial turnover shall be at least RS 1.7 Cr during last three financial years i. e. 2022-2023, 2023-2024 & 2024-2025 As a proof same bidder shall submit audited Profit & Loss statemen ts / balance sheets, where in UDIN number of auditor shall be mention.
